observations: Photo 0 shows a grey game console with two controllers (one black, one blue) on top.
Photo 1 shows the side of the console with a 'SONY' logo and a disc slot.
Photo 2 shows the top of the console with a 'SONY' logo and a 'PS4' logo.
The console has a matte grey finish.
The seller's text mentions 'UK used ps4 slim' and '2 controllers'.
The photos show a grey console, which is the standard color for the PS4 Slim model.

claims.evidence: The grey console in photos 0, 1, and 2 is the standard PS4 Slim model.
No accessories are shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controllers may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of both controllers being used to navigate the system menu.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty or unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of both controllers being used to navigate the system menu.
Video of a game disc being inserted and launched.
Video showing the console connected to the internet and logged into PSN.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
